title: SonicMaster: Towards Controllable All-in-One Music Restoration and Mastering
abstract: arXiv:2508.03448v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Music recordings often suffer from audio quality issues such as excessive reverberation, distortion, clipping, tonal imbalances, and a narrowed stereo image, especially when created in non-professional settings without specialized equipment or expertise. These problems are typically corrected using separate specialized tools and manual adjustments. In this paper, we introduce SonicMaster, the first unified generative model for music restoration and mastering that addresses a broad spectrum of audio artifacts with text-based control. SonicMaster is conditioned on natural language instructions to apply targeted enhancements, or can operate in an automatic mode for general restoration. To train this model, we construct the SonicMaster dataset, a large dataset of paired degraded and high-quality tracks by simulating common degradation types with nineteen degradation functions belonging to five enhancements groups: equalization, dyn

translated_title: SonicMaster：迈向可控的一体化音乐修复与母带处理
translated_abstract: 音乐录音常常存在音频质量问题，例如过度混响、失真、削波、音调失衡以及立体声声像狭窄，尤其是在缺乏专业设备或专业知识的非专业环境中创作时。这些问题通常需要借助多种单独的专业工具和手动调整来纠正。在本文中，我们提出了SonicMaster，这是首个用于音乐修复与母带处理的统一生成模型，能够通过基于文本的控制来处理广泛的音频缺陷。SonicMaster以自然语言指令为条件来执行针对性的增强处理，也可以在自动模式下运行以进行一般性修复。为了训练该模型，我们构建了SonicMaster数据集，这是一个包含成对退化音轨与高质量音轨的大型数据集，通过属于五个增强类别（均衡、动态等）的十九种退化函数来模拟常见的退化类型。
tldr: 提出了首个统一的生成式音乐修复与母带处理模型SonicMaster，通过自然语言指令实现对多种音频质量问题的可控一站式处理。
